strings.subtitle: — Daggkat fiche —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Fàttali ak bàyyi amul. Jëfandikoo butó bu nekk suuf.
strings.ft_lnk: Yoon bu gàtt (.lnk) — ñu koy bàyyi
strings.ssd_warning:
Artu! Ci SSD, yoonu bind ci kaw du wóor dagg ndax TRIM.
Program bii dey HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fiche "{name}" dinañu koy bind ci kaw te far ko.

Wéy?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FICHE BIÑU KO BIND CI KAW TE FAR KO
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS yooni xibaar yu wàll (ADS) duñu liggéey.
• USN tëriin duñu setal.
• Kopi niroo ak jokkoo niir
  (OneDrive ak yeneen) duñu jépp.
strings.status_full: Ci biñu koy bind ci kaw nëbb bi ak tus lépp. Delluwaale mënul — jumtukaayi dinañu gis tus rekk.
strings.status_fast: Bopp, tàq ak 4 MB taax bind nañu ci kaw. Leneen tàmbaliwul, waaye ndax mbopp yi, delluwaale bu mat bu jumtukaayi jaaykat mënul. Ngir kayitu xarba, jëfandikoo mod FEKK.
strings.status_empty: Fiche bi neen na, bind ci kaw soobul. Far nañu ko.
strings.error_permission: Mënul jot fiche bi. Dina doon ubbi ci beneen program. Tëj ko te jéemaat.
strings.error_not_found: Fiche biñu ko jotul. Dina doon far nañu ko ba noppi.
strings.error_is_symlink: Bii yoonu màndarga la. Yoon yiñu mënul dagg — fiche biñu koy xaar dina des bu wóor.
strings.error_reparse: Bii fiche bu barab la (OneDrive walla mel ni moom). Xibaar bi ci niir la, du ci disk — amul dara buñu mën dagg fii.
strings.error_not_file: Bii du fiche (dósie walla leneen). Bàyyi fiche.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fiche bii am na yeneen yoon yu wóor ({n} lépp). Yoon yu wóor amul bopp — tur lépp mën na. Su ñu dagg ci yoon bii, xibaar bi dinañu koy bind ci kaw te tëj 32 byte, waaye des bi dinañu koy mën jot ci yeneen yoon. Dagg yoon yi lépp bu njëkk.
strings.error_compressed:
Fiche bi ndomb na, xarba na walla tuuti na. Bind ak tus du wóor dagg xibaar yu yàgg ndax NTFS dey denc leen ci beneen yoon.

Tuuratu atribi bi: bëgg ndijóor → Njariñ → Sori → tuuratu màndarga "Ndomb" ak/walla "Xarba". Jéemaat SHREDDER.
